observations: Large yellow-painted welded steel box sections/girders stacked in an outdoor yard, bolted plate joints visible.
One section has a rusted circular cut-out, suggesting it was repurposed or cut from larger equipmentt.
Mobile crane with orange boom and cab visible in background (photo 0, 1).
Shipping container marked 'CHINA SHIPPING' in background (photo 3), not part of the sale, just yard context.
Ground is muddy/wet, items sit directly on soil, no weighbridge, scale, or measuring reference visible in any photo.
No weight tags, tonnage markers, or quantity count visible on any item.

claims.claim: Scrap Metals For Sale Any Quantities
claims.evidence: No weighbridge ticket, scale photo, or itemized count shown in any of the 4 photos; quantity claim cannot be checked remotely.

risks.risk: Actual weight/tonnage of the scrap lot is unknown, and scrap metal is priced by weight.
risks.proof: Photo or video of the lot on a weighbridge/scale with a legible ticket, or a itemized count with individual piece dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without a weight basis; worst case assumption of weight is not reliable enough even for a floor price

risks.risk: Material grade/composition (mild steel vs alloy vs mixed with non-ferrous) affects price per kg.
risks.proof: Close-up shot showing any stamped grade marking, or a magnet test clip, or a mill certificate if available.
risks.if_unproven: price as ungraded mixed mild steel scrap, the lowest common grade

risks.risk: Visible heavy rust and surface contamination (mud, possible coatings/paint) may reduce net recoverable metal weight.
risks.proof: Close-up of rusted/cut sections and any coating, plus a clean-weight statement from seller.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming gross weight includes non-metal contamination, i.e. discounted net yield

risks.risk: Site accessibility and loading conditions (muddy ground, crane required) affect buyer's pickup/transport cost, which is a hidden cost beyond the scrap price itself.
risks.proof: Wider site photo or video showing access road and whether crane/loading equipment is included in sale or must be separately arranged.
risks.if_unproven: assume difficult access, buyer bears full loading/haulage cost

risks.risk: "Any quantities" claim implies larger stock than what is shown in 4 photos; unverified inventory beyond the pictured pieces.
risks.proof: Full yard video walk-through or itemized photo list of all available pieces with sizes.
risks.if_unproven: price only the pieces actually shown, not the unverified larger claimed stock

proof_requests: Weighbridge ticket or scale photo showing total tonnage of the lot being sold.
Close-up of any grade stamp or a magnet test video to confirm ferrous mild steel.
Wider yard video showing full extent of 'any quantities' stock and site access for loading.
response.reason: Scrap metal is priced per unit weight, and none of the four photos show a scale, weighbridge ticket, or any quantity/tonnage reference, so even a worst-case price per the pictured pieces cannot be grounded in an actual weight figure.
